readings.Aries: Your half-life in any comfortable situation is shorter than you'd like to admit. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Taurus: Your sense of value — what things are worth, what people cost — is usually accurate. Check it again today. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Gemini: There is someone in your life who needs your full attention, not your cleverness. Give it to them. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Cancer: What you call being cautious is sometimes waiting to feel safe enough to begin. You may never feel safe enough. Begin anyway. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Leo: Your warmth is your superpower. Don't let the performance crowd it out. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Virgo: The thing you've been bracing for may not arrive. Let yourself relax slightly. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Libra: There is a preference you've been masking as uncertainty. Name the preference. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Scorpio: The wound is real. It is also not the whole story about you. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Sagittarius: You hold ideas loosely, which is beautiful. Hold the people in your life a little less loosely. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Capricorn: Someone you respect is watching and taking notes. Good. You know what you're doing. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Aquarius: There is a feeling underneath the analysis that the analysis is a way of not feeling. Set the analysis down briefly. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Pisces: Something you're avoiding is actually not as bad as what avoiding it costs you. The window for this is shorter than it looks.

Aries-Virgo.synthesis: In theory you stabilise each other. In practice, one of you always feels slightly extinguished.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
